name: GPU Voxelization Using OpenGL Image Atomics
definition: A technique that transforms continuous 3D polygonal meshes into a discrete, regular volumetric grid stored in GPU memory by projecting geometry along its dominant axis, rasterizing fragments without a traditional framebuffer, and utilizing fragment-stage image atomic operations to write directly into 3D textures without concurrency conflicts.
summary: GPU Voxelization Using OpenGL Image Atomics converts 3D meshes into voxel grids by projecting geometry along its dominant axis and using hardware atomics to resolve concurrency without a framebuffer.
